name: phenoxybenzamine
warnings: WARNING Phenoxybenzamine hydrochloride-induced alpha -adrenergic blockade leaves beta -adrenergic receptors unopposed. Compounds that stimulate both types of receptors may, therefore, produce an exaggerated hypotensive response and tachycardia.
interactions: Drug Interactions 2 – Phenoxybenzamine hydrochloride may interact with compounds that stimulate both alpha- and beta- adrenergic receptors (i.e. epinephrine) to produce an exaggerated hypotensive response and tachycardia (see WARNING ).
